# Rathinam Global University

> Rathinam Global University is a higher education institution located in Eachanari, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, offering undergraduate, postgraduate and research programmes across engineering, computing, artificial intelligence, business, commerce, biosciences, liberal arts, media, fashion, health sciences and sustainability.

Rathinam Global University provides academic programmes, research opportunities, international collaborations, industry-integrated education and student development initiatives.

## Main Website

- [Rathinam Global University](https://rathinamglobal.edu.in/): Official homepage of Rathinam Global University.

## Academics

- [School of Quantum Science, Computing & AI](https://rathinamglobal.edu.in/courses/school-of-quantum-science): Programmes in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, computer science and related fields.

## Research

- [Research and Development](https://rathinamglobal.edu.in/research): Information about research programmes, Ph.D. opportunities, publications, patents, grants and innovation activities.

- [Office of the Registrar](https://rathinamglobal.edu.in/research/registrar): Information about academic governance, administration and the Office of the Registrar.

## Global Affairs

- [Office of Global Affairs](https://rathinamglobal.edu.in/global-affairs): Information about international partnerships, student mobility, global immersion and academic collaborations.

## University Information

Rathinam Global University is located at:

Rathinam Techzone Campus,
Eachanari,
Coimbatore,
Tamil Nadu - 641021,
India.

The university focuses on academic excellence, research, innovation, entrepreneurship, industry collaboration and global education opportunities.
